scope: bounded operators on separable Hilbert spaces, interior upper-half-plane frequency, reciprocal frequency-independent coupling, value-level effective response

dispatcher.condition: D(z) is boundedly invertible on the declared upper-half-plane patch
D(z) has fixed closed range/support and B annihilates the kernel
the block is complementable through a certified common scale: D=T^(1/2)Dhat T^(1/2), B=C T^(1/2)
dispatcher.handler: factorized/form Schur complement C Dhat^-1 C*
dispatcher.topology: norm-holomorphic output; approximation topology separately declared

dispatcher.condition: a specified approximation/approach net has a bounded correction limit in a declared topology
dispatcher.handler: arc/net-groupoid-valued response, descending only when all admitted nets agree in that topology
dispatcher.topology: trace-norm, norm, strong or weak—never silently promoted

dispatcher.condition: no bounded complement or topology-labelled limit exists
dispatcher.handler: retain the interior or refuse elimination

branches.discriminant: bounded Moore-Penrose inverse and fixed support
strong but not norm convergence at alpha=1/2

branches.disposition: trace claims only for trace-class residue
weak response cannot promote to strong
one base point fixes dissipative square-root range class
use certified form branch or fall through; imaginary comparability alone is insufficient

branches.discriminant: equal visible compression and trace, unequal residues
branches.disposition: retain operator-valued measure or separating state family

branches.discriminant: direct versus factorized and frame-rotated correction
non-Fredholm compact T with bounded critical response
branches.disposition: Fredholmness is optional metadata, not the response gate

frontiers.reentryCondition: Declare closed operators, common form domains, graph topology and adjoint/domain transport.
Choose an a.e., weak, strong, norm or limiting-absorption boundary topology and a spectral-measure class.
Include off-diagonal imaginary parts and state a replacement passivity identity.
Replace Hilbert-space Douglas factorization and specify which range/complementability theorem survives.

boundedExhaustion.reason: Every bounded interior case is routed by existence of an ordinary inverse, closed-range inverse, certified generalized complement, topology-labelled bounded limit, or refusal. The strict topology and residue counterexamples prevent any further silent promotion.
